Where should I start?

Explore the three offer pages. A consultation is for focused guidance, The X Frame Method is an online course, and 1-1 coaching is the personalised support option. Final inclusions are awaiting client confirmation.

Is the course the same as 1-1 coaching?

No. The X Frame Method is a learning product. 1-1 coaching is a separate personalised service. [CLIENT TO CONFIRM: the exact support included in each offer]
